description: Ex Libris Higher-Ed Platform, consisting of Alma, Primo, Leganto, Esploro and Rialto, is an open platform that provides common cross-product services while ensuring reliability, security, and ease of integration with 3rd-party products and tools.
classification_evidence: Together, the Ex Libris Primo discovery and delivery system, the Rosetta system for the long-term preservation of digital assets, the Leganto system for managing course resource lists, the Esploro system for maximizing visibility, efficiency, and compliance of research activities, and the Alma library management solution constitute a platform for transforming the collection-focused library into an essential, service-focused component of a research institution.
